page_notes: Page 272 of PIR² (Attii) contains one entry explicitly attesting a legatus Augusti pro praetore: Q. Attius Celer (1350).
No other entries on this page explicitly mention the formula 'legatus Augusti pro praetore' or its abbreviations for their main subject.

problems.issue: Lemma transcription contains a typo: 'Q. ATTIVS CELER' should be 'Q. Attius Celer' (no all-caps, correct spacing and 'u' instead of 'V').

The exact_text 'Legatus Aug. pro pr. provinciae Thraciae sub Gordiano' is correct but slightly truncated. The full printed text is 'Legatus Aug. pro pr. provinciae Thraciae sub Gordiano t. 1—4; cf. Stein l. l. p. 66 sq.'.
problems.suggested_fix: Extend exact_text to include 't. 1—4; cf. Stein l. l. p. 66 sq.' for full verbatim accuracy.

problems.issue: Province text 'Thracia' is correct in content but should match the printed casus: 'Thraciae' (genitive).
The end date of 244 is inferred from Gordian III's death, but the text only says 'sub Gordiano' without specifying the exact end year. This is a minor over-interpretation.
problems.suggested_fix: Set date_normalized_end to null or add a note about the uncertainty.

problems.issue: Normalized name 'Quintus Attius Celer' is plausible but the praenomen 'Quintus' is not explicitly given in the printed text (only 'Q.').
problems.suggested_fix: Use 'Q. Attius Celer' as normalized_name or add a note about the praenomen expansion.

problems.issue: The relation_context for Cattius Celer is slightly misleading. The text says Stein doubts the reading, not that Cattius Celer is a direct relation. The comparison is epigraphic, not familial or career-related.
problems.suggested_fix: Clarify relation_context: 'Stein compares the epigraphic reading to Cattius Celer of tituli IX 2778 due to doubts about the transcription.'
